info.name: CRM - Proposal Generation Bot
info.description:
Every proposal endpoint, in the order the SAP BPA bot calls them.

Set the collection variables first:
  baseUrl   - http://localhost:8080 (or your dev-tunnel/ngrok URL)
  email     - a CRM login
  password  - its password
  dealId    - deals.id of a deal in the PROPOSAL stage

"1. Login" stores the access token and "2. Generate proposal" stores proposalId,
so the later requests need no manual copying.

The webhook request is the exception: it is unauthenticated and needs

NOTE ON dealId: this is deals.id - the value GET /api/deals returns as "id" and
the lead-conversion response returns as "dealId". It is NOT opportunityId
("OPP-000031"), which is a display reference derived from it.

NOTE ON THE STAGE: proposal.eligible-stages defaults to PROPOSAL alone, which is
narrower than the contract bot's list. This bot fires when a deal *reaches* the
proposal stage; "Proposal Accepted" is a later outcome and belongs to the
contract bot.

request.description:
The SAP BPA bot's first call.

Takes ~25-30 seconds: docx4j render plus a headless LibreOffice conversion. Set the request timeout to at least 60s.

Optional fields:
  proposalType      STANDARD_SALES_PROPOSAL | SOFTWARE_IMPLEMENTATION_PROPOSAL | PROFESSIONAL_SERVICES_PROPOSAL
  contactId         who it is addressed to (defaults to the account's primary contact)
  validUntil        ISO date; defaults to proposal.default-validity-days from today
  paymentTerms      overrides the configured default
  deliveryTimeline  overrides the configured default
  regenerate        true supersedes the deal's existing live proposal

Expected:
  201 Created - a proposal was generated
  200 OK      - a retry was absorbed; the existing proposal is returned unchanged

Errors:
  400 incomplete data (no billing address, no emailable contact, no owner, zero value, expired validUntil)
  404 unknown deal, or a deal in another organization
  409 deal not in an eligible stage, or a proposal already with the customer
  500 document generation or PDF conversion failed (recorded against the proposal)
Expected: 200. 404 if the proposal belongs to another organization.

Deliberately small, because the automation platform polls it.

Returns proposalId, dealId, status, sentForSignatureAt, signedAt, rejectedAt, updatedAt.

Statuses: GENERATING -> DRAFT -> SENT_FOR_SIGNATURE -> VIEWED -> SIGNED | REJECTED, plus FAILED and SUPERSEDED.

Expected: 200.

Expected: 200, Content-Type application/pdf, Content-Disposition attachment named PRP-000042.pdf, Cache-Control no-store.

404 when no PDF exists - either generation ran DOCX-only (contract.libreoffice.enabled=false) or the stored file is gone.

Use Postman's "Send and Download" to save it.
Every proposal in the caller's organization, newest first. Expected: 200.
